narrative_purpose: The dim full-bleed atmospheric backdrop the chapter's text floats over: the immense silhouette of Polyphemus hanging fixed and dark behind a low Pandoran horizon at the hour of eclipse, deep and low-contrast so overlaid text stays readable.
subject: The colossal dark silhouette of a banded gas giant hanging motionless behind a low, distant Pandoran horizon of forested ridges, most of it in shadow with only a thin rim and a few faint cloud bands catching dim light, as the sun sits hidden behind it. Vast hazy twilight sky.
scene: A wide panoramic vista from a high, far vantage at the hour of eclipse, deep atmospheric haze layering the distance, almost everything dissolving into murk. No bright focal subject; mood, not a figure to study.
camera: Ultra-wide panoramic vista from a very high distant vantage, horizon low in the frame.
light: Very dark and low-contrast; a faint cool rim along the planet's edge where the hidden sun leaks past, a dim glow along the far horizon; deep shadow everywhere else.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, barely-there cream-rust on the planet's rim, a faint cyan haze low on the horizon; overall dim.
style: Painterly atmospheric vista, soft, dark, immersive; detail dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low and soft throughout - deliberately dim and hazy so long-form text can float over it and stay legible.
composition: Low horizon; the giant planet's dark silhouette filling much of the upper frame; wide empty hazy sky; nothing bright competing for attention.
consistency_notes: Same banded gas giant Polyphemus as the cover, here vast and dim at eclipse. Must stay dark and low-contrast as a background layer, distinct from the crisp bright cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no bright focal point, no high contrast, no sharp foreground, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
